flags.text: "Add inline citation badges with hover and keyboard-focus previews to assistant answers." - PR #233 initially added these badges, but PR #244 removed that implementation during integration and deferred inline badges to #243. PR #245 later reintroduced them over sanitized Markdown, so this wording incorrectly presents #233’s implementation as an addition in the integrated changelog.

"**Citation badges in chat:** When the assistant cites a passage by title in an answer, a numbered badge appears beside it with a preview on hover or keyboard focus." - This rephrases the earlier inline-badge implementation, which was removed during integration. Badges were subsequently reintroduced over sanitized Markdown by #245; describing the earlier chat implementation as a separate current feature is misleading.

"You can check the source, heading, and snippet there; citations without a matching title remain in the numbered Sources list." - As part of the separate 'Citation badges in chat' entry, this presents the superseded #233 implementation as an additional shipped feature. The current badge and Sources-list behavior comes from #245.
